# Video muxer

`mediabunny-1.56.1.mjs` is the unmodified browser bundle `dist/bundles/mediabunny.min.mjs` from the npm package `mediabunny@1.56.1`, by Vanilagy. It loads only when video export starts. The editor sends it local Canvas frames and explicit timestamps; no media is uploaded.

- Package/source archive: https://registry.npmjs.org/mediabunny/-/mediabunny-1.56.1.tgz (includes the corresponding `src/` source).
- Upstream: https://github.com/Vanilagy/mediabunny

- API reference: https://mediabunny.dev/api/CanvasSource
- Retrieval date: 2026-09-12.
